complete_compiler_story.summary: Google Workspace added a one-click way for users to confirm system-applied classification labels in Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides. complete_compiler_story.headline: A scheduled Smartsheet prompt becomes a reusable exception digest

source.title: Schedule prompts to run automatically
source.scope: Reviewed the complete feature update and help guidance covering prompt schedules, read-only summaries, approval, email delivery, examples and permission boundaries.
source.freshness_reason: This 144-hour extended fallback supplied the one reusable Agent Skills procedure; the limited inspected sample found no newer supported nonduplicate scheduled-prompt procedure.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete feature update and help guidance covering prompt schedules, read-only summaries, approval, email delivery, examples and permission boundaries.

complete_compiler_story.summary: Smartsheet now lets users schedule prompts to run automatically and email generated summaries after approval. Its examples include recurring risk and status reviews, while the product remains read-only for these summaries. The release supports a reusable exception-digest procedure, but Smartsheet provides no independent productivity or accuracy measurement.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Create one weekly exception digest with a fixed prompt, named source sheet, approval owner, and recipient list. Compare each draft with the underlying rows, log corrections, and revise the prompt only after a recurring error pattern appears.
complete_compiler_story.related_coverage: Reviewed scheduling, read-only behavior, approval, delivery, example prompts and permission limits; procedure: choose one sheet, write a fixed exception prompt, schedule weekly, review every draft, send only after approval, and log corrections.
complete_compiler_story.image_alt_intent: A weekly calendar triggers a read-only exception digest that pauses at an approval checkpoint before email delivery.

audience_fit.intended_user: Operations managers who maintain recurring status or risk sheets and already review weekly summaries.
audience_fit.practical_action: Configure one fixed weekly exception prompt with a named source sheet, owner, and recipient list.
audience_fit.review_action: Compare every generated exception with its source row, record corrections, and approve only accurate drafts.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A reusable weekly digest process with visible review effort, correction history, and a human release decision.
